name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its flagship Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta Province, Argentina. The project is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study, positioning the company to achieve first production by 2029. AbraSilver is advancing Diablillos as one of the next major primary silver producers in South America.
